units.source_text: “我就是在夫人的善待下才慢慢变得快活起来的，

en.t: It was because of the mistress's kindness that I gradually became more cheerful,

units.source_text: 因此，我便想在K身上也尝试一下。

en.t: so I thought I would try the same thing with K.

units.source_text: 经过长期交往，我深知K和我在性格上有很大差异。

en.t: After knowing him for so long, I understood well that K and I were very different in temperament.

units.source_text: 但是，正如自从我入住这个家庭之后，棱角多少磨掉了些，

en.t: But just as, after I came to live in this household, my own rough edges were worn down somewhat,

units.source_text: 我想在这里，K的心早晚也会平静下来吧。

en.t: I thought that if K stayed here, his heart too would eventually grow calm.
